items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a tall, thin candle with a tiny flame on each side. You light it when you make a wish with your whole <radical form="忄">heart (left)</radical>.
items.description: Both are three strokes down the left edge. 忄 hangs a short dash on each side of one long vertical. 氵 has no vertical at all — just three separate slanting drops stacked downward.
items.image_prompt: A tall, thin candle stands upright on the left side of the picture. A tiny flame flickers out on each side of the top of the wick. A person with closed eyes makes a wish in front of it, hand on chest: <radical>heart (left)</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a measuring tool. It has a sharp point on top and small marks down its arm. You use it to measure an <radical form="角">angle</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A metal angle gauge held up against a window. Its two edges meet in a sharp point at the top, and a row of short degree marks runs down the arm below. A carpenter squints at it to check the <radical>angle</radical> of a wooden corner.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical is a combination of <part form="予">beforehand</part> and <part form="丿">slash</part>. A guard hooks a blade on top <part form="予">beforehand</part>, then a long shaft makes a <part form="丿">slash</part> down: a <radical form="矛">halberd</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a round head wearing a flat helmet. The head has a big chin and sits alone on a line. It rolled off a shelf. It is just a <radical form="疋">head</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A round, bald head with a jutting chin sits alone on a flat shelf line, with no body attached. A flat helmet brim lies across the top of it. The head looks surprised, as if it just rolled off the shelf and stopped there: a <radical>head</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two strokes that meet in a sharp point that turns inward. Anything that slides past gets caught. It is a <radical form="マ">hook</radical>.
items.image_prompt: Two metal strokes: one slants in from the left, and a second cuts back under it to a sharp point that turns inward like a small beak. A sock on a clothes line has slid past it and is now caught on the sharp point of the <radical>hook</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like three claw marks down a fence post. Each mark is a little shorter than the one above it. Count the marks: <radical form="彡">three</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A wooden fence post with three diagonal claw marks scratched into it, from top to bottom. Each mark is a little shorter than the one above. A small, proud cat sits beside the post, one paw raised, having just made all <radical>three</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a spear standing up. The blade on top tilts to strike, the shaft drops down, and a fist holds the grip at the bottom. That is a <radical form="殳">pike</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A long spear stands upright. At the top a slanted, hooked blade tilts forward, ready to thrust. A straight shaft drops down the middle, and at the base a strong fist is clenched around the grip. The weapon is a <radical>pike</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a shirt on a hanger. A collar is on top, the body drops down, and a sleeve flaps out and hits the clerk. It is <radical form="衤">clothing (left)</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A shirt on a hanger swings on a spinning dry-cleaner rack. The collar hooks out at the top, the straight body of the shirt drops down, and one sleeve flares sideways and smacks the surprised clerk in the face. It is a piece of <radical>clothing (left)</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a person seen from the side. A head is on top, a thick chest is in the middle, and the legs swing down below. It is a whole <radical form="身">body</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A person drawn from the side: a small head at the top, a thick torso pushed out through the middle, and one long stroke swinging down and away underneath for the legs. The whole shape shows the full <radical>body</radical>, standing proud.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="龶">sprout</part> and <part form="月">moon / month</part>. A small <part form="龶">sprout</part> climbs up, and a round <part form="月">moon / month</part> hangs below it. Both glow <radical form="青">blue-green</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A garden trellis at twilight. A young green sprout climbs up the top of it, and a fat, round moon hangs from the vine just below. The whole scene glows in one soft color between the sky and the sea: <radical>blue-green</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical is a combination of <part form="大">big</part> and <part form="丶">drop</part>. A <part form="大">big</part> animal has a <part form="丶">drop</part> on its shoulder. It spins and snaps at it, like any <radical form="犬">dog</radical>.
items.description: 大 (big) is just the figure with arms out, no extra mark anywhere. 太 (thick / fat) adds its dot low down, between the legs, like a belly bulge. 犬 adds its dot high up, by the shoulder, like the flea it keeps snapping at — the dot's height is the only difference between all three.
items.image_prompt: A big, happy animal stands with its legs spread wide. A single small dot sits high up by its shoulder. The animal spins in a tight circle, snapping at that spot again and again and never reaching it, just like a <radical>dog</radical> chasing its tail.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like half of a log split down the middle. Three broken branches stick out to the left. It is the <radical form="爿">left-side kata</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A log split cleanly down the middle. A person holds up the left half. Three short, snapped branch stumps stick out to the left, and the flat split side runs straight down on the right. That half piece is the <radical>left-side kata</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a long weapon leaning against a gate. It has a curved blade, and a guard's scarf is caught on the tip. The guard walks away, and down falls the <radical form="戈">halberd</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A long wooden shaft leans on a castle gate at a steep diagonal. A curved blade hooks off the side of the shaft. A guard walks past, his scarf snags on the tip at the top, pulls tight, and the whole weapon topples with a crash: a <radical>halberd</radical>.

items.image_prompt: Two arms reach up side by side. A single long bar lies straight across the top of both. They hold it up together, level, each one carrying the same weight. It is the work of <radical>two hands</radical>.
